description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarAccountEventFactory class, which creates CalendarAccountEvent objects from various data sources such as Meeting, Call, and Task beans within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for converting beans into events, handling date parsing, and managing relationships.

classes.name: CalendarAccountEventFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating CalendarAccountEvent instances from various data sources such as beans and source events.

methods.name: fromMeetingBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Meeting bean and CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromBean
methods.description: Converts a Meeting, Call, or Task bean into a CalendarAccountEvent, handling date parsing and event type determination.

methods.name: fromCallBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Call bean and CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromTaskBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Task bean and CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromSourceEvent
methods.description: Creates a new CalendarAccountEvent from an existing event and a new event ID.

methods.name: parseDateTimeString
methods.description: Parses a date string into a SugarDateTime object, checking formats and converting accordingly.
